item.title: cmd_status --watch loops forever after successful sprint — status is 'completed' not 'idle'
item.intent: After a sprint succeeds, cmd_status --watch must exit cleanly without user intervention.
steps: Locate the terminal-state check in cmd_status watch loop (~line 3549)
Add 'completed' as a terminal state alongside 'idle': [[ $sprint_status == 'idle' || $sprint_status == 'completed' ]]
Run shellcheck and verify no new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: Running cmd_status --watch exits automatically after a sprint completes with status 'completed' in sprint.json
Running cmd_status --watch still exits when sprint.json is absent or has status 'idle'
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
